definitions: The pinned draft defines the arms, protocol, observations, analysis and carry rule.

analysis_details.floor: No compared arm has a lower 95% final-mean bound above the exact random-policy test floor at the same cap.
analysis_details.too_easy: Use the original ablation ACS2 labels for both caps.
analysis_details.ceiling: Each of the two arms in the contrast has a final mean of at least 0.99 at the cap under analysis.
analysis_details.descriptive_steps: Weight by the registered pair distribution. Infer failed steps at the registered cap from original success and conditional solved steps. Divide the resulting weighted mean by the weighted mean shortest path of the same pairs.
analysis_details.cpu_ratios: Divide per-seed process CPU and per-seed utility CPU by the paired S+1 process CPU before taking medians per maze. Report peak memory from the measured process.

costs.model: Multiply each full 6a seed cost by the corresponding new arm-to-6a seed-42 process CPU ratio at the last common checkpoint. Use the observed ratio extrema at >=100k as scenario bounds. A complete pilot supplies its final process CPU; partial observations use schedstat samples.
costs.limits: Use the maximum 6a seed cost, the upper matched ratio floored at one, and 1.41 attempt spread, plus 120s. Scout with the seed-42 6a cost and the same factors. The dependent initial envelope uses the entire scout reservation, multiplied by the 6a maximum-to-42 seed ratio and 1.41, plus 120s. After a successful scout replace its reservation by its charged allocation CPU in that formula. Round limits up to a minute.

scout_gate.dependency: Submit each dependent array behind the full-budget seed-42 scout gate. Validate accounting and reproduce the pilot prefix before updating the dependent time limits. Stop if any resulting limit exceeds the initial envelope or a scout fails.

authorization: No grid submission until explicit approval states a CPU-hour limit covering the approved envelope and existing spend.
